title: (English C1) Technical Support Associate (remotely)
description: Who are we? SupportYourApp is a global Intelligent Support-as-a-Service leader, partnering with tech companies and industry leaders like MasterCard, Calm and MacPaw in 30+ countries since 2010 to deliver secure customer and technical support. We operate globally, supporting clients in 60 languages across diverse industries. So what if you had a chance to be a part of the world's leading SaaS, software, or hardware solutions? Join our community as a Technical Support Associate on a short-term basis, with the potential to continue into a long-term collaboration. Unlock your potential by mastering new skills and achieving challenging goals in cooperation with our People First management approach. Excited? Let's see what it takes 💛 What you will do: Handle support requests by email and chat, and join occasional customer calls to review issues live; Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support: troubleshoot, reproduce issues, and escalate complex cases; Diagnose issues using internal tools, logs, configuration files, and databases; Escalate to engineering, delivery, sales, or customer service, and keep customers updated on escalated cases; Handle routine configuration maintenance and test customer configuration changes; Help customers understand the platform, its best practices, and its limits so they can solve issues on their own; Monitor chatbot workflows and suggest improvements What you need to succeed in this role: Excellent English communication skills (at least C1 for both spoken and written); 1-3 years of experience in customer support, ideally in SaaS or a technical environment; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and empathetic approach; Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. You can juggle multiple tasks and priorities without losing track; An analytical mindset and a knack for recognizing patterns in support data; Hands-on experience with Zendesk and Jira; Confidence working with technical tools and admin interfaces; Practical experience using generative AI to improve operational workflows and customer-facing work; Personal computer (at least 8Gb of RAM) with a stable internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps-download and 40 Mbps-upload) Will be a great plus: Background in software development, APIs, or another technical role Benefits: Fixed schedule: Monday-Friday: 09 AM-5 PM CDT; Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely; Inclusive international environment; Compensation in USD; Balance between project workload and personal time; Responsive leadership interested in your development; Greenhouse conditions for self-development; A culture built on trust, with no time-tracking requirements The items listed in this section may vary depending on the terms of your engagement. Certain benefits and conditions typically apply to employees; independent contractors may not be eligible for all of these. The specific terms, including compensation, benefits, and work conditions, will be clearly defined in your agreement if selected You can learn more about the company and its culture by visiting our official website and social pages on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. So if you're a proactive Technical Support Associate who thrives on solving problems, ensuring customer satisfaction, and delivering outstanding service, don't miss this opportunity and send us your CV in English to collaborate with us! Over 1500+ specialists who already deliver exceptional customer experiences collaborating with SupportYourApp. Know someone perfect for the role? Refer them and get rewarded! We adhere to the principles of equal treatment of candidates and prohibit discrimination on any grounds protected by law. Your personal data will be processed as described in the SupportYourApp Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Software Engineer (Remote)
description: We build consumer AI products downloaded by millions. We ship fast, work close to the newest models, and build as a team: engineers, designers, and product working side by side from the first prompt to production. We're hiring a Software Engineer whose core focus is turning LLM capabilities into product: agentic pipelines, tool calling, streaming — the layer where AI actually becomes a feature people use daily. What You'll Do Build and ship AI/LLM features end-to-end: API integration, prompt & system design, tool/function calling, multi-step agent pipelines, streaming responses. Make those features production-grade: fast, reliable, safe, and cost-efficient at scale. Design and maintain backend services in Node.js + TypeScript , backed by Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Cloud Functions). Hunt down bottlenecks across the backend and inference layers — latency, memory, and model/infra cost. Contribute to our Flutter apps when product work spans client and backend. Work directly with product and design to take features from concept to launch. What We're Looking For Hands-on LLM experience is the core requirement — prompt engineering, tool calling, and agentic workflows in real products, beyond a single chat call. An AI-native way of working: you prototype fast with AI dev tools and reason about model behavior, strengths, and limits. 2+ years of professional software development experience. Strong backend engineering with Node.js and TypeScript (services, async, streaming). Experience with Firebase, and a solid grasp of architecture, scalability, and performance. Nice to Have GCP/AWS, containers, serverless Sandboxed code execution Working proficiency in Flutter/Dart
